metadata.binding: custom ctypes C ABI to official SM_API; not official SmPyLib wheel
metadata.properties: official SmBrep::ComputePreciseProperties core integration at requested relative accuracy, no SM_API 1e-4 area/centroid clamp
metadata.native_valid_check: AssertValid(SM_LEVEL_2, SM_WALK) and IsManifoldSolid for nonempty
metadata.empty_check: no material/bounded void regions or faces/edges/vertices
metadata.input_ownership: fresh native primitives for each invocation; native boolean consumes inputs
metadata.tolerance_configuration: SM_USE_OLDTOL: public SmTol::SetModelSizeEstimate before context/primitives, then public SetTolerance(tol,FALSE,FALSE) on fresh input Brep/faces/edges/vertices before boolean; result tolerance never overwritten; reads effective edge/vertex tolerances; no solver edits; classification separate
metadata.build: AppleClang 21 C++17 Release arm64; old official core reused unchanged

cap_boundary_probe.method: SmBrep.Point3DClassify on native result; all probe coordinates outside sharp input; only tests supplied points, not whole-surface equality
